evidence.reason: Moved terminal-event lookup out of the per-job identity loop in `canonical()` so every job's id, ledger equality, and `sourcePr`/`pr` binding is verified (throwing on mismatch) before any `null` return, preventing a later job's PR comment from being posted to an unvalidated source PR; added a regression test covering a first job with no fixed event and a later job with a mismatched `sourcePr`. Local tests were not run (harness permits only git commands); full suite is CI's authority.
